Case note: CS(COMM) 2224/2020
Client: Neha Bhatt (architect, Vadodara)
Opposing party: Vindhya Aviation Ltd
Court: Gujarat High Court, before Justice Arvind Bhargava
Filed on: 30/04/2020
Claim amount: ₹135.5 crore
Issue: aircraft lease repossession. The airline sought protection from its creditors.
Advice given: Argue that leased aircraft fall outside the insolvency moratorium.
Outcome: The aircraft were released from the moratorium.
Recommended next step: Repossess the aircraft.
Witness: Swati Iyengar
Matter code: Project Kestrel
